result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, RoleClient::configure_direct_peer seeds ClientRequestMetadata only for protocol versions >= 2026-07-28. Peer::send_request delegates to send_request_with_option with PeerRequestOptions::no_options, and Peer::call_tool_once delegates to send_request, so the concrete ordinary call_tool_once path supplies no explicit per-request meta and cannot override the seeded protocolVersion/clientCapabilities values. In the option-bearing path, send_request_with_option_and_subscription seeds protocolVersion, clientInfo and clientCapabilities first, then applies options.meta through request.get_meta_mut().extend(meta), and only afterward sets progressToken. RequestMetaObject::extend delegates to MetaObject::extend, whose source contract overwrites existing keys on conflict. Therefore explicit PeerRequestOptions.meta can replace the JSON values of either 2026-07-28 required key io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion or io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities when an option-bearing request API is used. This overwrite behavior is source-proven at the pinned commit but is not exercised by ordinary call_tool_once/send_request. Server-side validation of overridden values remains unresolved.
